problems.issue: The word 'again' is wrong for Kim Yong-hyun. At first instance the special counsel sought 25 years for him and the court imposed 30; on appeal it raised its request to 30. It is correct only for Yoon, where 30 years was sought at both levels. 'Approved' should also read 'approved in advance' to match the quote. The other facts check out: Yeo 20 years (Yonhap/Supple, The Fact, Gyeongbuk Maeil and YTN; only News Tomato says 15, apparently a typo), Kim Yong-dae 5 years, ruling Dec 4 at 3 p.m., Criminal Division 1 under judge Yoon Sung-sik, and the 'judicial terror' remark.
problems.fix: At the closing hearing on October 16, 2026, the special counsel sought 30 years for Yoon, as it had at first instance, and 30 years for Kim Yong-hyun, up from the 25 years it sought at first instance. It sought 20 years for Yeo In-hyung and five years for Kim Yong-dae, arguing that the offense was graver than insurrection. In his final statement, Yoon called the first-instance ruling judicial terror disguised as a trial and said there was no evidence he had approved the drone operation in advance. The Seoul High Court's Criminal Division 1 (presiding judge Yoon Sung-sik) set its ruling for December 4, 2026.
problems.evidence: Supple/Yonhap (2026-10-16, 종합): Kim Yong-hyun was sought 25 years at first instance and 30 now; Yoon 30 at both levels; Yeo 20; Kim Yong-dae 5. Gyeongbuk Maeil (2026-10-16) says Kim Yong-hyun's request was raised from 25 to 30. The Fact (2026-10-16) quotes '제가 작전을 사전 승인했다는 증거도 없다' and the '사법테러' remark, ruling Dec 4 at 3 p.m.
